maket.bulmaca.3: The ball runs along the goal line. It slips past the near post, then banks off the corner at the far post into the goal. A ball that goes behind the post stops in the side netting.
maket.bulmaca.7: The lane is the narrow channel behind the seats. The corner at an empty seat drops the ball through the gap one row down; two rows are descended this way. The hole is in the channel of the lowest row.
maket.bulmaca.14: Zigzag between the partitions. The floor slopes towards the drain; the hole is the drain itself. A ball in the puddle counts as out (test value).

maket.bulmaca.1: The lane bends along the centre circle line. Three training cones on the line block the straight way: the ball goes round the outside of the cones to the outer edge, bounces off it and comes back to the line. On the way back there is a narrow two-cone gate: after the bounce the ball must pass through it (positions TRIAL). The hole is on the line.
maket.bulmaca.2: The lane runs from inside the pitch to the touchline; its end is open and the touchline itself is the boundary (decision: Kemal). Three large sprinkler heads stand in a triangle (positions TRIAL): two in the middle block the straight line, the third near the right edge closes the bank shot on the right. The only way is a bank off the left edge. The hole sits just before the line: too much power sends the ball out.
maket.bulmaca.4: The lane turns the corner from the touchline onto the goal line; here the lane is narrow (0.90 m, miniature standard lane). The corner flag post stands in the middle of the turn: the ball goes round its outside and bounces off the angled edge. On the narrow lane there is little room between post and edge.
maket.bulmaca.5: Breather. The start is on the penalty area line, the hole is the penalty mark itself. Three wall mannequins (position TRIAL) block the straight shot; the ball passes beside the wall, bounces once off the oval edge and turns onto the mark.
maket.sema.kavis: oval edge: turns the ball onto the mark
maket.bulmaca.6: The lane runs from the grass to the stand, passes under the railing onto the dirt and turns along the foot of the first step towards the stairs. The lane comes down right onto a railing post: a straight shot hits it. The ball passes beside the post down to the narrow side (0.36 m) at the foot of the first step; from there it runs along the narrow side, past two posts, to the hole at the foot of the stairs.
maket.bulmaca.8: The ball runs a long way in the channel of the top row, behind the seats. The corner at the end of the channel turns it through the gap in the back wall onto the bridge. The bridge is flat concrete without edges, 0.6 m wide (decision: Kemal), and slopes slightly down to the wall: a ball that falls off counts as out (TRIAL). The hole is on the landing on top of the stone wall; its back has an edge.
maket.bulmaca.9: Breather. The lane is the corridor itself: one side is the back wall of the stand, the other the stone wall. A bridge pier blocks the straight line. Sideline benches stand at the foot of the stone wall (TRIAL): the ball rolls under the seat, but a ball that hits the legs at the ends does not reach the wall. A ball played to the wall between two benches bounces cleanly, passes between the pier and the wall and turns to the hole behind the corner of the stand.
maket.sema.merdivenAyagi: foot of the stairs: hole on the narrow side
maket.sema.kopruAcik: no edges: a fallen ball is out
